label: A_tI2_139_a-001
title: In ($A6$) Structure
comments:
The \href{current_web_home_dir/A_tI2_139_a-001}{indium ($A6$)} and \href{current_web_home_dir/A_tI2_139_a-002}{protactinium ($A_{a}$)} structures have the same AFLOW prototype label, A\_tI2\_139\_a. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files. 
 The ICSD lists both structures under the high-pressure Sn(tI2) structure type.  We instead follow the {\em Strukturbericht} designation and assign structures with $c/a > 1$ to $A6$ while $A_{a}$ has $c/a < 1$. 
 We did not find an ICSD entry for (Deshpande, 1969) so we used the ICSD entry from (Ridley, 1965). (Deshpande, 1969) report a = 4.6002{\AA} and c = 4.9463{\AA} while (Ridley, 1965) reports a = 4.5994{\AA} and c = 4.9461{\AA}, so the two lattices are practically indistinguishable. 
 Our report of this structure in (Mehl, 2017) stated that (Deshpande, 1969) reported this structure in a face-centered tetragonal lattice.  This is an error dating back to the original \href{https://www.atomic-scale-physics.de/lattice/index.html}{{\em Crystal Lattice Structures}} page.  The lattice constants are those of the \href{https://aflow.org/prototype-encyclopedia/Tutorials/Crystallography_Part3_Bravis/\#sec:body_centered_tetragonal}{standard conventional unit cell of a body-centered tetragonal lattice}.  We thank Bochuan Sun of Hampton University for pointing this out.
